description: This file defines the ExternalOAuthProvider class, which extends the Basic class to implement OAuth provider functionality within the SuiteCRM ecosystem. It includes methods for managing OAuth configurations, access control, and integration with the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProvider
classes.description: Implements OAuth provider logic within SuiteCRM, including configuration management, access control, and security features.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Overrides parent retrieve to add access control checks.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides parent save to include access verification.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Determines if current user has access to personal OAuth provider instances.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denial event for non-admin users attempting to access personal accounts.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the bean implements specific interfaces, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Checks user's access rights to specific actions based on ACL rules.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a custom query for listing OAuth provider records with user access considerations.

methods.name: getRedirectURI
methods.description: Builds the OAuth redirect URI based on site configuration.

methods.name: getConfigArray
methods.description: Returns the provider configuration array, merging defaults and stored values.

methods.name: deserializeMapField
methods.description: Deserializes JSON fields used for storing arrays in the database.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth scope string from stored JSON data.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Returns extra provider parameters from deserialized JSON.

methods.name: getTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Returns token request options from deserialized JSON.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Returns refresh token request options from deserialized JSON.

methods.name: getAuthorizeUrlOptions
methods.description: Returns authorize URL options from deserialized JSON.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the grant type for refresh token requests, defaulting to 'refresh_token'.

methods.name: getTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the grant type for token requests, defaulting to 'authorization_code'.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMapping
methods.description: Returns the JSON field name for access token mapping, defaulting to 'access_token'.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenMapping
methods.description: Returns the JSON field name for refresh token mapping, defaulting to 'refresh_token'.

methods.name: getExpiresInMapping
methods.description: Returns the JSON field name for token expiry info, defaulting to 'expires_in'.

methods.name: getTokenTypeMapping
methods.description: Returns the JSON field name for token type, defaults to empty string.
